messages:
Alex P: quick sync
We need a minimal, safe pattern to deprecate v1 per-route. Criteria: no surprise billing, clear telemetry, easy rollback. thoughts?
Tanya R: +1 keep it simple: preview (no billing/quota) -> staged (gradual weight) -> cutover. preview runs a sampled simulation and gives CI.
Dmitri K: telemetry: tag requests with deprecation_mode=preview|staged|live and cohort=control|shadow|optin. metrics: deprec.latency.p95_delta_ms, deprec.quality.regress_pct, deprec.billing.estimate_usd_p50.
Leah S: console UX: banner with "Preview" CTA that runs job (0.1%/1%/5%). modal shows median cost delta + 90% CI, p95 delta, and a few redacted sample outputs. include privacy opt-out.
Alex P: router sketch: if header X-CL-Version==v2 or route.pinned==v2 -> route v2. else if route.deprec_state==preview -> sample to v2 for telemetry and route to v1. staged -> increase v2 weight by step_pct every N minutes.
Tanya R: previews must not count toward quotas. show preview_quota_estimate tokens/day for planning. staged/live respect quotas and billing immediately.
Dmitri K: alerting: auto-pause staged if regress_pct > 2% for 15m or p95 delta >50ms. ops-bot to open incident and notify owner.
Leah S: small design ask: add a "confidence" meter (0-100) in the banner based on sample size + regression signals. also a timeline of deprecation events on the route page.
Alex P: assignments: Dmitri -> RFC for metric names + tags, Tanya -> router prototype for sampling + stepper, Leah -> modal copy & mock, Alex -> runbook for auto-pause & rollback. aim alpha behind feature flag in 3w.
console-bot: NOTE: enabling preview emits audit event route.deprecation.preview.started and auto-creates a temporary dashboard for 14 days.
ops-bot: ALERT: if deprec.billing.estimate_usd_p50 > 50% over baseline for 1h during staged move -> pause and notify finance + owner.
Alex P: ok I'll create tickets and link PRs here. thanks all. end.
